title: Fix historical parity PaperPosition stable tuple hashing
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Apply the focused fix identified by the requested Net PnL investigation: make historical Gross/Net parity use one reproducible canonical stable-tuple hash for PaperPosition from candidate preparation through donor preview and mutation validation, so an unchanged position is not deferred as an invariant conflict.
inScope: HistoricalGrossNetParity preparation and hash binding for PaperPosition targets whose proved originating entry is before the existing 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC cutoff.
Removal of the redundant PaperPosition-only anonymous-object hash representation so TargetTupleHash is derived from the existing normalized CanonicalPayloadJson used by storage rereads.
Focused unit and PostgreSQL integration regression coverage for PaperPosition candidate preparation and donor preview hash compatibility.
Required requirement-contract validation, build/test verification, independent semantic review, and project context/history bookkeeping.
outOfScope: Any change to Net ROI = Gross ROI - 3.3 percentage points, Fee arithmetic, Gross PnL, Gross ROI, basis, donor hierarchy or donor matching.
Any change to descending current-Gross strategy ordering, one-strategy-at-a-time completion, cutoff, batch sizes, timeouts, retry policy, reconciliation, or completed-row preservation.
Any change to Live or post-cutoff accounting, trading signals, execution, order placement, settlement, configuration, schema, or API behavior.
Production database mutation, service deployment, restart, configuration mutation, or trading action.
scope.periodOrFilter: Only the existing historical Gross/Net parity PaperPosition path governed by the unchanged originating-entry cutoff strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC.
scope.firstVerification: Compare the deployed PaperPosition candidate CanonicalPayloadJson fields, processor TargetTupleHash construction, storage donor-preview reread payload, production row hashes, runtime conflict logs, and current test coverage before editing.

requirements.text: Carry out the focused PaperPosition hash fix identified by the Net PnL investigation so an unchanged historical position can proceed through donor preview.
acceptanceCriteria: For PaperPosition, the prepared TargetTupleHash equals SHA-256 of its normalized CanonicalPayloadJson and therefore reproduces the hash calculated by the existing storage reread for the same unchanged row.

A real PostgreSQL flow that loads a PaperPosition candidate, prepares the target, and passes its TargetTupleHash to LoadHistoricalGrossNetParityDonorPreviewAsync returns Complete rather than InvariantConflict when the stable tuple has not changed.

The stable tuple continues to include position identity, mapped strategy identity, wallet, market/outcome identity, size, average price, and all persisted Fee accounting fields already present in CanonicalPayloadJson.
Volatile mark-to-market and row-version fields already excluded from CanonicalPayloadJson remain excluded, so ordinary valuation updates do not create a false stable-tuple conflict.
